title: Bawa parent dari kelas ke checkout pembayaran
description:
## Background / Problem

Academic catalog enrollment sudah memvalidasi parent, student ownership, publication, enrollability, schedule capacity, dan `Idempotency-Key`, lalu mengembalikan transaction ID serta checkout URL. Capability tersebut belum dapat digunakan dari web.

## Goal

Parent dapat memilih student dan schedule yang valid, membuat enrollment sekali, lalu melanjutkan ke checkout Duitku.

## Requirements

* Enrollment dimulai melalui catalog enrollment endpoint, bukan direct billing transaction.
* Parent memilih student miliknya serta schedule yang tersedia.
* Setiap submission memiliki idempotency key yang stabil untuk retry yang sama.
* Detail kelas publik dan student management yang sudah ada harus tetap terjaga.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Parent dapat memilih student/schedule dan menerima checkout URL untuk enrollment sah
- [ ] Double-submit atau retry tidak membuat enrollment atau invoice ganda
- [ ] Full capacity, unpublished/closed class, ownership failure, dan billing failure ditampilkan dengan tepat
- [ ] Existing functionality remains unaffected
- [ ] Error and validation scenarios are handled correctly

## Technical Notes

Gunakan `POST /api/v1/catalog/classes/:class_id/enrollments`. Jangan mengirim nominal dari browser langsung ke billing. Idempotency key harus mewakili satu intent enrollment dan tidak dibuat ulang pada retry identik.

Relevant areas:

* `kelolakelas-web/app/(public)`
* `kelolakelas-academic-service/internal/delivery/http/handler/enrollment_handler.go`
* `kelolakelas-academic-service/internal/usecase/enrollment_usecase.go`

## Edge Cases

* Schedule penuh setelah halaman detail dimuat.
* User menekan submit beberapa kali.
* Enrollment tersimpan tetapi invoice provider sementara gagal.

## Testing / Validation

- [ ] Relevant unit tests are added or updated
- [ ] Relevant integration tests are added or updated
- [ ] Existing tests pass
- [ ] Lint passes
- [ ] Type checking passes
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are manually or automatically verified

## Out of Scope

* Voucher.
* Multi-class cart.
* Pemilihan payment provider selain Duitku.
